title: The Founding Identity: How Gujarat Titans Became More Than an IPL Entry
dek: Every franchise starts with a first season and a first squad. Gujarat Titans' began in 2022; what that year looked like still shapes how they are seen.
excerpt: Gujarat Titans played their first season in 2022, led by HH Pandya with the bat and Mohammed Shami with the ball. Some of that first squad stayed long enough to become the franchise's foundation.

sections.heading: More Than an Entry
body: A franchise becomes more than a team in a league when it builds continuity: players, a home ground and a recognisable way of playing that outlast a single season.

sections.heading: What the First Season Did Not Decide
body: First seasons are not destiny. Results, squads and owners change; the founding year is a starting point, not a prediction.
The later history of GT is told season by season elsewhere in this series.
